question: Can response class and feasible participation intervals identified from new development streams predict disjoint new streams without retuning?
interval_rule: The predicted feasible grid is the smallest contiguous rho interval containing every development rho with success rate at least 0.5; an empty development set predicts empty.
negative_result_policy: Retain every mismatch, false-safe prediction, monotone response, plateau and unresolved response.
claim_boundary: Sequentially frozen within-domain software prediction using new disjoint random streams; not leave-domain-out transfer, physical experiment, HIL or source-controller replay.
